description: This file implements the class methods for VertexArrayGL, managing OpenGL vertex array objects, including state synchronization, buffer bindings, attribute configurations, and validation within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: VertexArrayGL
classes.description: Class managing OpenGL vertex array objects, including state synchronization, attribute configuration, and validation.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes the vertex array and associated buffers, resetting internal state.

methods.name: syncClientSideData
methods.description: Synchronizes client-side vertex data for drawing.

methods.name: updateElementArrayBufferBinding
methods.description: Updates the binding for the element array buffer.

methods.name: syncDrawState
methods.description: Synchronizes the draw state, including streaming attributes and index data.

methods.name: syncIndexData
methods.description: Prepares index data, streaming if necessary, for draw calls.

methods.name: computeStreamingAttributeSizes
methods.description: Calculates sizes needed for streaming vertex attributes.

methods.name: streamAttributes
methods.description: Streams vertex attribute data into buffers for drawing.

methods.name: getVertexArrayID
methods.description: Returns the OpenGL vertex array object ID.

methods.name: getAppliedElementArrayBufferID
methods.description: Returns the ID of the currently applied element array buffer.

methods.name: updateAttribEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a vertex attribute array based on current state.

methods.name: updateAttribPointer
methods.description: Updates the vertex attribute pointer configuration.

methods.name: supportVertexAttribBinding
methods.description: Checks if the platform supports vertex attribute binding.

methods.name: updateAttribFormat
methods.description: Updates the format of a vertex attribute.

methods.name: updateAttribBinding
methods.description: Updates the binding index of a vertex attribute.

methods.name: updateBindingBuffer
methods.description: Updates the buffer bound to a vertex binding point.

methods.name: updateBindingDivisor
methods.description: Updates the divisor for instanced rendering on a binding.

methods.name: syncDirtyAttrib
methods.description: Synchronizes changes in vertex attribute state.

methods.name: syncDirtyBinding
methods.description: Synchronizes changes in vertex binding state.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes the entire vertex array state based on dirty bits.

methods.name: applyNumViewsToDivisor
methods.description: Adjusts the divisor based on the number of views for multi-view rendering.

methods.name: applyActiveAttribLocationsMask
methods.description: Applies a mask to enable or disable vertex attributes based on active locations.

methods.name: validateState
methods.description: Validates the current VAO state against OpenGL driver state for debugging.
